clips.text: Two thousand. Netflix is losing money.
They offer the whole company to Blockbuster. Fifty million dollars.
Fifty million dollars. That was the entire company.
The offer was declined. Not a negotiation. A no.
Two thousand and ten: bankruptcy. Twenty twenty-one: the other side.
Two accounts. One meeting. The founders say they offered. The chief executive says no talks.
Tomorrow: the camera Kodak invented, then hid. The Decision File. Episode two.
